detail.venueAddressBody: King Abdullah Park, Al Malaz, Riyadh 12836
detail.venueTransitBody: Metro Line 2 to Al Malaz (7 min walk). Paid parking in lots C and D, ⃁ 20.
detail.venueAccessBody: Step-free entry at Gate 3. Wheelchair bays in the seated tier — book by phone.
detail.fixtureAbout: Riyadh's winter season opens with a full-scale outdoor production in King Abdullah Park — four acts, a 40-metre stage and a park laid out for 8,000 people. Gates open at 18:30 with food stalls, a market and family seating on the eastern lawn; the main set begins at 20:00 and runs to 23:30. The show goes ahead in all weather.
detail.fixtureFooterNote: You'll pick seats on the hall map, then sign in to pay. Earn cashback to your MyTicket wallet.
detail.fixtureAssurance1: Tickets are issued for the event and verified by MyTicket.
detail.fixtureAssurance2: Payment is held securely and released after the event.
detail.fixtureAssurance3: Your QR code works offline in the MyTicket app.
detail.reviewMohammedBody: Sound was excellent even at the back of the field. Entry through Gate 3 took five minutes with the app ticket.
detail.reviewHalaBody: Great atmosphere and the family lawn was genuinely comfortable. Food queues got long around 21:00.
detail.reviewKhalidBody: Gold pit is worth it if you want to be close, but arrive by 19:00 or you'll be behind the early crowd.
